about: The taps the engine will write and the reference adapter (models/deepseek41/reference.py `taps`) writes, in program order, for the flash geometry's 40 backbone layers. The first entry whose name matches, in its layers when given, applies; {nn} is a two-digit layer. A skeleton: the bundle's tap writer and the reference adapter align their names with this file as each lands; the DSpark stages and the vision encoder add their entries with their lanes.

Names follow docs/reference-runner.md ("Taps and tapdiff") (tools/refrun/taps.py's grammar). cols is the full width; a col_shards rank holds cols / ranks of it. detail: written only in the layers CHOPINFER_TAPS_LAYERS names.

taps.name: embed.out
taps.layout: streams x hidden (4 x 5120); the token embedding expanded to the mHC streams, layer 0's input

taps.name: L{nn}.in.streams
taps.layout: streams x hidden (4 x 5120); the layer's input streams, F32

taps.name: L{nn}.x.engram
taps.layout: hidden; the Engram contribution added before the layer

taps.name: L{nn}.x.hc.attn
taps.layout: hidden; the streams collapsed into the attention sublayer's input by the lagged pre weights

taps.name: L{nn}.attn.in
taps.layout: hidden; attn_norm

taps.name: L{nn}.x.q_latent
taps.layout: the normalized query latent (q_norm) the queries and the indexer read

taps.name: L{nn}.x.latent
taps.layout: the normalized key-value latent (kv_norm), its last 64 channels rotated, as the window ring holds it before quantization

taps.name: L{nn}.x.indexer.ids
taps.layout: selected compressed positions, 2^32 - 1 where none

taps.name: L{nn}.attn.core
taps.layout: query heads x 512 after the inverse tail rotation, the input of wo_a

taps.name: L{nn}.attn.out
taps.layout: hidden; the all-reduced wo_b output

taps.name: L{nn}.x.hc.mlp
taps.layout: hidden; the streams collapsed into the MoE sublayer's input

taps.name: L{nn}.mlp.in
taps.layout: hidden; ffn_norm

taps.name: L{nn}.router.logits
taps.layout: experts; sqrt(softplus) scores before the bias

taps.name: L{nn}.router.weights
taps.layout: top-6 weights after normalization and the 1.5 scale, in the order of router.ids

taps.name: L{nn}.router.ids
taps.layout: top-6 expert ids

taps.name: L{nn}.moe.routed
taps.layout: hidden; the routed experts' weighted sum, F32 partials

taps.name: L{nn}.moe.shared
taps.layout: hidden; the shared expert's F32 partials

taps.name: L{nn}.mlp.out
taps.layout: hidden; the all-reduced routed and shared sum

taps.name: L{nn}.out
taps.layout: streams x hidden (4 x 5120); the layer's output streams

taps.name: final.x.hc.head
taps.layout: hidden; the streams collapsed by the sigmoid-weighted head before the final norm

taps.name: final.norm
taps.layout: hidden
